def choose_move(observation):
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position")
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position")
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []
    obstacles = observation.get("obstacles") or []
    width = observation.get("grid_width", 10)
    height = observation.get("grid_height", 10)

    def safe_move(dx, dy):
        nx, ny = sx + dx, sy + dy
        if 0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height and (nx, ny) not in obstacles:
            return True
        return False

    # Prioritize capturing resources
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda c: abs(c[0]-sx)+abs(c[1]-sy))
        dx = (1 if target[0]>sx else -1) if target[0]!=sx else 0
        dy = (1 if target[1]>sy else -1) if target[1]!=sy else 0
        if safe_move(dx, dy):
            return [dx, dy]

    # Move away from opponent if close
    dist_x, dist_y = ox - sx, oy - sy
    if abs(dist_x)+abs(dist_y) <= 2:
        dx = -1 if dist_x>0 else (1 if dist_x<0 else 0)
        dy = -1 if dist_y>0 else (1 if dist_y<0 else 0)
        if safe_move(dx, dy):
            return [dx, dy]

    # Else, move randomly to unblocked direction
    for dx, dy in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
        if safe_move(dx, dy):
            return [dx, dy]

    # No safe move found, stay still
    return [0,0]
